# Fixture: anonymous-chain pattern (mitigated)

The investigation found that someone in the chain authorized the destruction of the records before the auditors arrived. The public record does not identify which office issued the authorization; the inspector's report names only the witnessing clerk.

In the months that followed, a higher office reversed the decision without comment, according to the GAO summary released the next year.

Approval came from above, though contemporaneous notes show only routine sign-offs at the immediate supervisor level. [CITE: gao-2019-summary-p47]
